coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The official announcement says the service covers the Jiyuan demonstration zone's completed mapped and registered parcels/buildings.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The service entry page was fetched, but the visual-map route redirected to the Henan government login flow. The public application's config endpoint returned encrypted data and no anonymous parcel response, schema, CRS, or native ID was verified.

technicalBlocker: The official map route DZZZXZ_jy.aspx redirected through /userinfo/login.aspx and /ZWFWW/Authorized.aspx to login.hnzwfw.gov.cn. The linked public map app at http://221.13.152.245:7878/ was reachable, but its /api/ZdQsdc/readOnemapJson response was encrypted; unauthenticated /api/ZdQsdc/mainList returned 服务端加密异常. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe fields were used.
remainingUncertainty: The official service may expose parcel geometry to an authenticated or browser-mediated session, and the public app may require encrypted request parameters. No exact-point hit or absence inference is made.
nextStep: Hold runtime integration. A later researcher may qualify an anonymous first-party parcel endpoint only after independently verifying schema, CRS, stable native identity, and safe ID-plus-geometry output.
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement point; not shifted to force a parcel hit.
